preferred_classroom_ids.description: Replaces the list: at most 10 active classrooms, each once; [] clears it.

AvailabilitySettingsUpdate.title: AvailabilitySettingsUpdate
AvailabilitySettingsUpdate.description:
A change to the tutor's teaching limits and preferred classrooms
(``PATCH /api/v1/tutors/{user_id}/availability/settings``) with the
availability ``version`` the caller loaded. Fields not sent stay
unchanged; a limit sent as null is cleared.

AvailabilityWindow.title: AvailabilityWindow
AvailabilityWindow.description:
One weekly window, ``[starts_at, ends_at)`` in local time on an ISO
weekday. Never crosses midnight.

BusinessSettingsDetail.title: BusinessSettingsDetail
BusinessSettingsDetail.description:
The center's business settings (``GET /api/v1/business-settings``).

``operating_hours`` lists the open weekdays, by weekday; a weekday that
is not listed is closed.

anyOf.description: An IANA time zone key, e.g. America/Mexico_City.

BusinessSettingsUpdate.title: BusinessSettingsUpdate
BusinessSettingsUpdate.description:
A change to the settings (``PATCH /api/v1/business-settings``) with the
``version`` the caller loaded. Fields not sent stay unchanged; ``null``
(or an empty string) clears a contact field; ``null`` is ``422`` for
``center_name``, ``time_zone`` and ``operating_hours``.
``operating_hours``, when sent, replaces the whole week (0 to 7 entries,
one per weekday).

CalendarSubject.title: CalendarSubject
CalendarSubject.description: The session's subject with its level's name.

ClassSessionCalendar.title: ClassSessionCalendar
ClassSessionCalendar.description:
The sessions overlapping the range, by ``starts_at`` then ``id``; at
most 1000, with ``truncated`` true when more match.

ClassSessionCalendarItem.title: ClassSessionCalendarItem
ClassSessionCalendarItem.description:
One session on the calendar (#57 A4). ``markers`` are computed on
read, in a fixed order (``center_closed``, ``tutor_not_qualified``).

tutor_user_id.title: Tutor User Id
tutor_user_id.description: The tutor to offer the session to; null creates it unassigned.

classroom_id.title: Classroom Id
classroom_id.description: The classroom; null is no room.

ClassSessionCreate.title: ClassSessionCreate
ClassSessionCreate.description:
A one-off individual session (``POST /api/v1/class-sessions``).

Groups and courses (#56, #65) extend ``kind``; overrides (#49) add an
``override`` member, which is an unknown field until then.

ClassSessionCreated.title: ClassSessionCreated
ClassSessionCreated.description: The created session and its warnings (always empty until #50).

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: The room's weekly windows (at most 28; windows of one weekday may touch but not overlap). Empty: no time restriction.

ClassroomCreate.title: ClassroomCreate
ClassroomCreate.description:
A new classroom (``POST /api/v1/classrooms``). It starts active;
without ``availability`` it has no time restriction.

ClassroomDetail.title: ClassroomDetail
ClassroomDetail.description:
One classroom. ``availability`` is ordered by weekday, then start;
empty means no time restriction.

ClassroomReference.title: ClassroomReference
ClassroomReference.description:
A classroom as another module's record shows it (#197 preferred
rooms): its id, current name and whether it is still active (an inactive
room stays referenced and is shown as such).

anyOf.description: The room's weekly windows (at most 28; windows of one weekday may touch but not overlap). Empty: no time restriction.

ClassroomUpdate.title: ClassroomUpdate
ClassroomUpdate.description:
A change to a classroom with the ``version`` the caller loaded. Fields
not sent stay unchanged; ``availability``, when sent, replaces all the
room's windows (``[]`` clears them).

ClosureCheck.title: ClosureCheck
ClosureCheck.description:
Whether the center is closed on a local date
(``GET /api/v1/closures/check``): the active closures that contain it.

starts_on.title: Starts On
starts_on.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (no time zone).

ClosureCreate.title: ClosureCreate
ClosureCreate.description:
A new center closure (``POST /api/v1/closures``): whole local days,
inclusive, at most 366 days apart. It starts active.

ClosureDetail.title: ClosureDetail
ClosureDetail.description: One closure. ``starts_on`` and ``ends_on`` are inclusive local dates.

anyOf.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (no time zone).
A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (no time zone).

ClosureUpdate.title: ClosureUpdate
ClosureUpdate.description:
A change to a closure with the ``version`` the caller loaded. Fields
not sent stay unchanged.

scope.description: student_login (a guardian allows a minor's login) or guardian_academic_access (an adult student shares academic records with this guardian).

guardian_id.title: Guardian Id
guardian_id.description: For student_login, the guardian who consents; for guardian_academic_access, the guardian who receives access. An active guardian linked to the student.

method.description: Staff: paper or in_person. A guardian or a student: in_app.

ConsentGuardianOption.title: ConsentGuardianOption
ConsentGuardianOption.description: A linked guardian the viewer may name in a consent.

login_state.description: The linked login's state, or null when none is linked.

current_notice_version.title: Current Notice Version
current_notice_version.description: The privacy-notice version a new consent records.

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.description: Staff: every linked guardian; a guardian: themselves; a student: their own linked guardians.

consents.title: Consents
consents.description: Active records first, then by granted_at, newest first.

can_record.title: Can Record
can_record.description: The scopes the viewer may record now (by role and age).

ConsentOverview.title: ConsentOverview
ConsentOverview.description:
A student's consents as the viewer may see them (``GET
/api/v1/students/{student_id}/consents``).

notice_version.title: Notice Version
notice_version.description: The privacy-notice version current when it was given.

can_revoke.title: Can Revoke
can_revoke.description: The viewer may revoke it now.

suspends_login_on_revoke.title: Suspends Login On Revoke
suspends_login_on_revoke.description: Revoking it would suspend the student's login (the last valid student_login consent of a minor with an active login).

ConsentRecordItem.title: ConsentRecordItem
ConsentRecordItem.description: One consent record as the viewer sees it.

student_login_suspended.title: Student Login Suspended
student_login_suspended.description: The revocation suspended the student's login.

CourseCompletion.title: CourseCompletion
CourseCompletion.description:
The completion criteria, derived from the template: the minimum
attendance (null: none), then the required modules and assessments, in
position order.

CourseTemplateAssessment.title: CourseTemplateAssessment
CourseTemplateAssessment.description:
One assessment definition, by position (1-based); ``module_id`` null
is the whole course.

id.title: Id
id.description: An assessment of this template to keep (PUT only); none creates one.

module_index.title: Module Index
module_index.description: The 0-based index of its module in this body's modules; null is the whole course.

CourseTemplateAssessmentWrite.title: CourseTemplateAssessmentWrite
CourseTemplateAssessmentWrite.description:
One assessment definition of a written template; its position is its
index in ``assessments`` plus one.

CourseTemplateDetail.title: CourseTemplateDetail
CourseTemplateDetail.description: One template with its modules, assessments and completion criteria.

id.title: Id
id.description: A module of this template to keep (PUT only); none creates one.

subject_id.title: Subject Id
subject_id.description: One of the template's subject_ids, or null.

materials.title: Materials
materials.description: Free-text materials references (no files or links).

CourseTemplateModuleWrite.title: CourseTemplateModuleWrite
CourseTemplateModuleWrite.description:
One syllabus module of a written template; its position is its index
in ``modules`` plus one.

CourseTemplateReplace.title: CourseTemplateReplace
CourseTemplateReplace.description:
The new content of a template (``PUT
/api/v1/course-templates/{template_id}``) with the ``version`` the caller
loaded. It replaces the whole content: modules and assessments left out
are deleted.

CourseTemplateSubject.title: CourseTemplateSubject
CourseTemplateSubject.description:
A subject of a template, with its level's current name.
``is_active`` is false when the subject or its level was deactivated
after it was linked (it stays linked).

CourseTemplateSummary.title: CourseTemplateSummary
CourseTemplateSummary.description:
A template in the list. ``total_minutes`` is ``session_count`` ×
``session_minutes``.

EducationLevelCreate.title: EducationLevelCreate
EducationLevelCreate.description:
A new education level (``POST /api/v1/education-levels``). Without
``sort_order`` the level goes last (the current maximum + 10, at most
9999). It starts active.

EducationLevelDetail.title: EducationLevelDetail
EducationLevelDetail.description:
One education level. ``active_subject_count`` counts only its active
subjects.

EducationLevelReference.title: EducationLevelReference
EducationLevelReference.description:
A level as another module's record shows it (#33): its id, current
name and whether it is still active (an inactive level stays assigned and
is shown as such).

EducationLevelUpdate.title: EducationLevelUpdate
EducationLevelUpdate.description:
A change to a level (``PATCH /api/v1/education-levels/{level_id}``)
with the ``version`` the caller loaded. Fields not sent stay unchanged.

EmergencyContact.title: EmergencyContact
EmergencyContact.description: One emergency contact; ``position`` 1 is called first.

relationship.title: Relationship
relationship.description: Free text, for example Madre or Vecina.

EmergencyContactCreate.title: EmergencyContactCreate
EmergencyContactCreate.description: A new emergency contact. Its place in the list is its ``position``.

relationship.title: Relationship
relationship.description: Free text, for example Madre or Vecina.

EmergencyContactUpdate.title: EmergencyContactUpdate
EmergencyContactUpdate.description:
An emergency contact in a ``PATCH``: with the ``id`` of one of this
student's contacts to keep (and update) it, without one to add it.

FamilyCreate.title: FamilyCreate
FamilyCreate.description: A new family (``POST /api/v1/families``): active, with no members.

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.description: Every guardian of the family for a viewer with a staff role; only their own profile for a guardian.

version.title: Version
version.description: Send it back with every change.

FamilyDetail.title: FamilyDetail
FamilyDetail.description:
One family with its members, each list by family names then given
names. A guardian viewer sees only their own profile in ``guardians``.

FamilyGuardianItem.title: FamilyGuardianItem
FamilyGuardianItem.description: A guardian profile of the family.

FamilyListItem.title: FamilyListItem
FamilyListItem.description:
One family in the list (no guardian count: a guardian viewer can't
learn how many co-guardians exist).

FamilyReference.title: FamilyReference
FamilyReference.description: The family a student or guardian belongs to (#172 E1).

FamilyStudentItem.title: FamilyStudentItem
FamilyStudentItem.description:
A student of the family. Membership is not access: the student's own
record still follows the viewer's links.

FamilyUpdate.title: FamilyUpdate

FieldError.description: One field-level error: location, Pydantic error type and message.
FieldError.title: FieldError

GuardianAccount.title: GuardianAccount
GuardianAccount.description: The linked login, shown only to ``family.manage`` holders.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: An account with the guardian role that isn't archived.

GuardianCreate.title: GuardianCreate
GuardianCreate.description:
A new guardian profile (``POST /api/v1/guardians``). It starts active.
``user_id`` links a login account (one that holds the ``guardian`` role
and isn't archived).

students.title: Students
students.description: By family names, then given names.

family.description: The family this profile belongs to (#172); null when it belongs to none or the viewer may not see it.

version.title: Version
version.description: Send it back with every change.

GuardianDetail.title: GuardianDetail
GuardianDetail.description:
One guardian profile. ``account`` is ``null`` unless the viewer holds
``family.manage``.

GuardianListItem.title: GuardianListItem
GuardianListItem.description: One guardian in the list. No contact data (spec §16).

GuardianStudentItem.title: GuardianStudentItem
GuardianStudentItem.description: A student linked to the guardian.

GuardianUpdate.title: GuardianUpdate
GuardianUpdate.description:
A change to a guardian profile (``PATCH /api/v1/guardians/{id}``) with
the ``version`` the caller loaded. ``null`` clears ``email``, ``phone``
and ``user_id``.

HealthStatus.title: HealthStatus
HealthStatus.description: The success body of both health probes.

username.title: Username
username.description: Normalized like a login username: 3 to 64 characters from a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-' (letters are not case-sensitive).

InvitationCreate.title: InvitationCreate
InvitationCreate.description: Invite one person for one role (``POST /api/v1/invitations``).

invitation_url.title: Invitation Url
invitation_url.description: APP_ORIGIN + '/invite#token=' + the one-time token. Show it once; never store or log it.

InvitationIssued.title: InvitationIssued
InvitationIssued.description:
A new invitation link (``201``) or a replacement (``200`` on reissue).

``invitation_url`` holds the one-time token in its fragment. It is shown
in this response only: never stored, logged or returned again.

status.title: Status
status.description: active: the latest link can still be used.

issued_at.title: Issued At
issued_at.description: When the latest link was issued.

InvitationListItem.title: InvitationListItem
InvitationListItem.description:
One open invitation: a pending user without a password who has an
invitation link. Holds no token or hash.

InvitationLookup.title: InvitationLookup
InvitationLookup.description: Who an invitation link is for, so the page can show the username.

InvitationRedeemRequest.title: InvitationRedeemRequest
InvitationRedeemRequest.description: The token and the new password (``POST …/invitation/redeem``).

InvitationTokenRequest.title: InvitationTokenRequest
InvitationTokenRequest.description: The token from an invitation link (``POST …/invitation/lookup``).

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description: Username and password. The bounds do not depend on any account.

NotificationItem.title: NotificationItem
NotificationItem.description:
One of the caller's notifications. The client renders the message from
``notification_type`` and ``params``; ``read_at`` is null while unread.

NotificationReadAllBody.title: NotificationReadAllBody
NotificationReadAllBody.description:
``up_to``: the newest notification the caller has seen; only that one
and older ones are marked read. ``null`` marks every unread one.

OperatingHoursItem.title: OperatingHoursItem
OperatingHoursItem.description: The opening interval of one weekday, in the center's local time.

PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange
PasswordChange.description: The signed-in user's current and new password (``POST /auth/password``).

username.title: Username
username.description: The user's username (normalized like a login username; letters are not case-sensitive).

PasswordResetCreate.title: PasswordResetCreate
PasswordResetCreate.description: Issue a reset link for one user (``POST /api/v1/password-resets``).

reset_url.title: Reset Url
reset_url.description: APP_ORIGIN + '/reset#token=' + the one-time token. Show it once; never store or log it.

PasswordResetIssued.title: PasswordResetIssued
PasswordResetIssued.description:
A new password-reset link (``201``).

``reset_url`` holds the one-time token in its fragment. It is shown in this
response only: never stored, logged or returned again.

PasswordResetLookup.title: PasswordResetLookup
PasswordResetLookup.description: Who a reset link is for, so the page can show the username.

PasswordResetRedeemRequest.title: PasswordResetRedeemRequest
PasswordResetRedeemRequest.description: The token and the new password (``POST …/password-reset/redeem``).

PasswordResetTokenRequest.title: PasswordResetTokenRequest
PasswordResetTokenRequest.description: The token from a reset link (``POST …/password-reset/lookup``).

version.title: Version
version.description: The version shown to the user; it must be the current one.

PrivacyNoticeAcceptanceRequest.title: PrivacyNoticeAcceptanceRequest
PrivacyNoticeAcceptanceRequest.description:
The version the user read and accepts
(``POST /api/v1/privacy-notice/acceptance``).

PrivacyNoticeAccepted.title: PrivacyNoticeAccepted
PrivacyNoticeAccepted.description: An acceptance of the current version (the first one, when repeated).

body_es.title: Body Es
body_es.description: The Spanish text: plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines.

body_en.title: Body En
body_en.description: The English text: plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines.

accepted_at.title: Accepted At
accepted_at.description: When the caller accepted this version, or null.

ProblemDetails.description: The body of every error response (RFC 9457 Problem Details).
ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails

QualificationCreate.title: QualificationCreate
QualificationCreate.description: A tutor's request to teach one subject (the level follows from it).

rejection_reason.title: Rejection Reason
rejection_reason.description: The reviewer's reason; set only for rejected.

revoked_at.title: Revoked At
revoked_at.description: When the approval was revoked; set only for revoked.

revocation_reason.title: Revocation Reason
revocation_reason.description: The reviewer's revocation reason; set only for revoked.

QualificationItem.title: QualificationItem
QualificationItem.description: One qualification of a tutor, with its subject and level names.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the qualification is revoked; the tutor sees it.

QualificationRevoke.title: QualificationRevoke
QualificationRevoke.description: A reviewer withdraws an approved qualification (#198 B1).

ReauthenticateRequest.title: ReauthenticateRequest
ReauthenticateRequest.description: The current user's password (#26). The same bounds as login.

reauthenticated_until.title: Reauthenticated Until
reauthenticated_until.description: When the 5-minute reauthentication window of this session ends (ISO 8601, UTC). Activity does not extend it.

ReauthenticateResponse.title: ReauthenticateResponse
ReauthenticateResponse.description:
The end of the session's reauthentication window (#26).

Holds no token, hash or session id.

username.title: Username
username.description: Normalized like a login username: 3 to 64 characters from a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-' (letters are not case-sensitive).

RegistrationSubmitted.title: RegistrationSubmitted
RegistrationSubmitted.description: The answer to a registration request (``202``). Holds no id.

SchedulingConflict.description:
One broken scheduling rule (ADR-0005): its code, whether it is
``hard`` (never allowed) or ``soft`` (allowed with an override), and
code-specific details.
SchedulingConflict.title: SchedulingConflict

booking_notice_hours.title: Booking Notice Hours
booking_notice_hours.description: Hours of notice a booking needs (0 = none).

change_notice_hours.title: Change Notice Hours
change_notice_hours.description: A family's cancellation or reschedule later than this many hours before the start is late (0 = never late before the start).

response_hours.title: Response Hours
response_hours.description: Hours a tutor has to answer an offer (ADR-0005 D3).

makeup_after_on_time.title: Makeup After On Time
makeup_after_on_time.description: A makeup is allowed after an on-time cancellation.

makeup_after_late.title: Makeup After Late
makeup_after_late.description: A makeup is allowed after a late cancellation.

makeup_after_no_show.title: Makeup After No Show
makeup_after_no_show.description: A makeup is allowed after a no-show.

makeup_window_days.title: Makeup Window Days
makeup_window_days.description: Days after the missed class within which a makeup happens.

based_on_id.title: Based On Id
based_on_id.description: The id of the latest version (the current one or the last upcoming one); otherwise 409 version_conflict.

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: When it takes effect: now when omitted; otherwise not in the past and later than every existing version (422 invalid_effective_from).

SchedulingPolicyCreate.title: SchedulingPolicyCreate
SchedulingPolicyCreate.description:
A new version: every rule, the latest version it replaces and when it
takes effect.

booking_notice_hours.title: Booking Notice Hours
booking_notice_hours.description: Hours of notice a booking needs (0 = none).

change_notice_hours.title: Change Notice Hours
change_notice_hours.description: A family's cancellation or reschedule later than this many hours before the start is late (0 = never late before the start).

response_hours.title: Response Hours
response_hours.description: Hours a tutor has to answer an offer (ADR-0005 D3).

makeup_after_on_time.title: Makeup After On Time
makeup_after_on_time.description: A makeup is allowed after an on-time cancellation.

makeup_after_late.title: Makeup After Late
makeup_after_late.description: A makeup is allowed after a late cancellation.

makeup_after_no_show.title: Makeup After No Show
makeup_after_no_show.description: A makeup is allowed after a no-show.

makeup_window_days.title: Makeup Window Days
makeup_window_days.description: Days after the missed class within which a makeup happens.

SchedulingPolicyItem.title: SchedulingPolicyItem
SchedulingPolicyItem.description:
One policy version, in force from ``effective_from`` until the next
version's ``effective_from``.

upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.description: Versions that take effect later, oldest first.

history.title: History
history.description: Versions no longer in force, newest first (at most 50).

SchedulingPolicyOverview.title: SchedulingPolicyOverview
SchedulingPolicyOverview.description: The version in force now, the upcoming ones and the past ones.

SchedulingWarning.title: SchedulingWarning
SchedulingWarning.description: A rule that never blocks (ADR-0005 warnings; filled by #50).

SessionClassroom.title: SessionClassroom
SessionClassroom.description: The session's classroom (an inactive room stays shown as such).

SessionSubject.title: SessionSubject
SessionSubject.description:
The session's subject with its level's name. ``is_active`` is false
when the subject or its level is inactive.

SessionTutor.title: SessionTutor
SessionTutor.description: The tutor the session is offered to, or who teaches it.

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token
csrf_token.description: The session's CSRF token: send it as X-CSRF-Token on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. Keep it in memory only.

privacy_notice_required.title: Privacy Notice Required
privacy_notice_required.description: True until the user accepts the current privacy-notice version (#174). Meanwhile every route except /auth/me, /auth/logout, /auth/me/preferences and the privacy-notice routes answers 403 privacy_notice_required.

preferences.description: The user's stored UI language and theme (#36); null when never stored. The web app applies them at sign-in.

center_time_zone.title: Center Time Zone
center_time_zone.description: The center's IANA time zone (business settings, #37). The web app shows instants and computes today's date in it.

SessionUser.title: SessionUser
SessionUser.description:
The signed-in user (``POST /auth/login``, ``GET /auth/me`` and
``POST /auth/password``).

Holds no password hash, session token or session id. ``csrf_token`` is
the session's CSRF token: the SPA keeps it in memory and sends it as
``X-CSRF-Token`` on ``POST``, ``PUT``, ``PATCH`` and ``DELETE``.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: An account that isn't archived and isn't linked to another student, or null to unlink.

StudentAccountUpdate.title: StudentAccountUpdate
StudentAccountUpdate.description:
Link a login account to the profile, or ``null`` to unlink it (``PUT
/api/v1/students/{student_id}/account``), with the ``version`` the caller
loaded.

birthdate.title: Birthdate
birthdate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900-01-01 up to today in the center's time zone.

school_grade.title: School Grade
school_grade.description: Free text, for example 2.º de secundaria.

education_level_id.title: Education Level Id
education_level_id.description: An active level of the catalog.

StudentCreate.title: StudentCreate
StudentCreate.description:
A new student profile (``POST /api/v1/students``). It starts active.
The list order of ``emergency_contacts`` (1 to 5) is their order.

education_level.description: Shown even when the level is inactive.

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.description: The linked guardians, by family names then given names; null unless the viewer holds a staff role and guardian.view.

family.description: The family this profile belongs to (#172); null when it belongs to none or the viewer may not see it. Shown only to viewers with a staff role and guardian.view.

login.description: The linked login account (#35); null when none is linked or the viewer doesn't hold family.manage.

version.title: Version
version.description: Send it back with every change.

StudentDetail.title: StudentDetail
StudentDetail.description:
One student profile. ``personal`` is ``null`` for a viewer with
limited access (Finance Staff, assigned tutors, a linked guardian of an
adult student). ``guardians`` is ``null`` for viewers without a staff
role and ``guardian.view``.

has_account.title: Has Account
has_account.description: The profile is linked to a login.

StudentGuardianItem.title: StudentGuardianItem
StudentGuardianItem.description: A guardian linked to a student, as staff see it on the student.

is_minor.title: Is Minor
is_minor.description: Under 18 today in the center's time zone (ADR-0007 D17).

StudentListItem.title: StudentListItem
StudentListItem.description: One student in the list. No birthdate or contact data (spec §16).

StudentLogin.title: StudentLogin
StudentLogin.description:
The student's login account, shown only to ``family.manage`` holders
(#35 C3).

StudentPersonal.title: StudentPersonal
StudentPersonal.description: The personal part of a profile, only for full-access viewers.

anyOf.description: YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900-01-01 up to today in the center's time zone.

StudentUpdate.title: StudentUpdate
StudentUpdate.description:
A change to a profile (``PATCH /api/v1/students/{student_id}``) with
the ``version`` the caller loaded. ``emergency_contacts``, when sent, is
the complete new list (contacts left out are removed).

SubjectCreate.title: SubjectCreate
SubjectCreate.description: A new subject of the level in the path. It starts active.

SubjectDetail.title: SubjectDetail
SubjectDetail.description: One subject with its level's id and current name.

SubjectUpdate.title: SubjectUpdate
SubjectUpdate.description:
A change to a subject (``PATCH /api/v1/subjects/{subject_id}``) with
the ``version`` the caller loaded. The level can't be changed.

TeachingLimitsDetail.title: TeachingLimitsDetail
TeachingLimitsDetail.description:
A tutor's teaching limits (#197), in minutes; null is no limit (no
break). Exceeding them is a warning when scheduling (M4-05), never a
block.

TeachingSubject.title: TeachingSubject
TeachingSubject.description:
A subject the tutor holds an **approved** qualification for (#44 D1).
A subject deactivated later stays, with ``subject_is_active`` false.

weekly.title: Weekly
weekly.description: The weekly windows by weekday, then start.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.description: By starts_on, then starts_at (whole days first).

preferred_classrooms.title: Preferred Classrooms
preferred_classrooms.description: By name. A room deactivated after it was chosen stays, with is_active false.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version of the weekly windows, limits and preferred classrooms together; 0 while they were never changed.

TutorAvailabilityDetail.title: TutorAvailabilityDetail
TutorAvailabilityDetail.description:
A tutor's availability in the center's local wall-clock time, with
the teaching limits and preferred classrooms (#197).

version.title: Version
version.description: The profile's version; 0 while the tutor has no stored profile (the first edit creates it, at version 1).

editable_fields.title: Editable Fields
editable_fields.description: The fields the caller may change, sorted; empty: read only. Sending another field is 403 permission_denied.

teaching_subjects.title: Teaching Subjects
teaching_subjects.description: The subjects of the tutor's approved qualifications, by the level's order, then the subject name.

TutorDetail.title: TutorDetail
TutorDetail.description: One tutor profile, with what the caller may edit.

TutorListItem.title: TutorListItem
TutorListItem.description:
One tutor: a user holding the ``tutor`` role, with the account's
contact fields.

TutorOption.title: TutorOption
TutorOption.description:
A user holding the tutor role, for the calendar's tutor filter. No
contact data.

TutorOptions.title: TutorOptions
TutorOptions.description: The matching tutors, in the user list order.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version the caller loaded (0: no profile yet).

TutorUpdate.title: TutorUpdate
TutorUpdate.description:
A profile change (``PATCH /api/v1/tutors/{user_id}``). Fields not sent
stay unchanged; ``""`` or ``null`` clears ``email``, ``phone`` or
``professional_experience``.

assignable_roles.title: Assignable Roles
assignable_roles.description: Roles the caller may add to and remove from this user, in the catalog order (empty: the roles are read-only).

manage_delegations.title: Manage Delegations
manage_delegations.description: The caller may grant and revoke this user's delegated permissions (an Owner, and the user holds administrator).

UserAllowedActions.title: UserAllowedActions
UserAllowedActions.description:
What the caller may do to this user, computed by the server with the
routes' rules (the routes stay the authority). The last-active-Owner guard
is not considered (the server answers ``409 last_active_owner``).

UserDelegationsUpdate.title: UserDelegationsUpdate
UserDelegationsUpdate.description:
The Administrator's complete set of delegated permissions (``PUT
/api/v1/users/{user_id}/delegations``) and the version the caller
loaded.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Role codes, in the catalog order.

version.title: Version
version.description: Send it back with every change.

delegations.title: Delegations
delegations.description: Delegated permission codes, sorted (changed with PUT /api/v1/users/{user_id}/delegations).

password_set.title: Password Set
password_set.description: Whether the account has a password: a pending account without one is an open invitation, with one a registration request.

UserDetail.title: UserDetail
UserDetail.description: One user's account. Holds no password hash or token.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Role codes, in the catalog order.

UserListItem.title: UserListItem
UserListItem.description:
One user in the list. No contact fields, password data or delegations
(spec §16: minimal exposure).

language.description: The UI language, or null when never stored.

theme.description: The theme choice, or null when never stored.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description:
The signed-in user's stored preferences (``SessionUser.preferences``).

``null`` means the user has never stored the value.

UserPreferencesUpdate.title: UserPreferencesUpdate
UserPreferencesUpdate.description:
``PATCH /api/v1/auth/me/preferences``: one or both values.

A field that is not sent stays as it is. ``null`` is refused (a stored
value can't be cleared), so is an empty body and any other field.

UserRolesUpdate.title: UserRolesUpdate
UserRolesUpdate.description:
The user's complete set of roles (``PUT /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles``)
and the version the caller loaded. At least one role: a roleless account
is only a registration request (#169).

UserStateChange.title: UserStateChange
UserStateChange.description: Suspend, archive or reactivate: the version the caller loaded.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description:
A profile change (``PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_id}``). Fields that are not
sent stay unchanged; ``""`` or ``null`` clears ``email`` or ``phone``. The
username never changes (ADR-0007 D7).

version.title: Version
version.description: The availability version the caller loaded (0: never changed).

windows.title: Windows
windows.description: At most 42 windows; windows of one weekday may touch but not overlap. Local wall-clock times of the center.

WeeklyAvailabilityUpdate.title: WeeklyAvailabilityUpdate
WeeklyAvailabilityUpdate.description:
The tutor's full list of weekly windows
(``PUT /api/v1/tutors/{user_id}/availability/weekly``); ``[]`` clears
them.
